title: Tab
drDigitalIntro:
The Tab key jumps your cursor forward to the next spot.
• On a keyboard, you will find Tab on the far left side, above Caps Lock — it often has an arrow or the word 'Tab'.
• In a form with multiple boxes, Tab skips from one box to the next without touching the mouse.
• Shift+Tab goes backwards to the previous box.
• Try it now: the activity below has buttons linked together — Tab moves you forward, Shift+Tab moves you back, and Enter clicks.
drDigitalSuccess: You filled in the whole form with Tab and Enter. The mouse stayed where it was.
drDigitalHint: Press Tab to move to the next button, Shift+Tab to go back, and Enter to click the highlighted one.
